title: Unlimited Purchase Commitment
text: The Customer irrevocably agrees to purchase no less than $5,000,000 of products in every contract year, with no maximum purchase ceiling and no right to reduce quantities, even if the Customer's business needs change.

title: Immediate Payment on Demand
text: The Supplier may demand immediate payment of any amount it alleges is owed. Payment is due within 24 hours of demand, whether or not an invoice is complete or disputed. The Customer waives any right to withhold disputed amounts.

title: Automatic Penalties
text: For each alleged breach, the Customer shall pay a penalty of $1,000,000 per occurrence, in addition to all other damages and costs, without a stated aggregate cap or requirement to demonstrate actual loss.

title: Compounding Default Charges
text: Any unpaid amount shall incur a charge of 5% per week, compounded weekly, until paid in full, in addition to collection costs and any other remedies available to the Supplier.

title: Unlimited Customer Liability
text: The Customer assumes unlimited liability for all direct, indirect, incidental, consequential, special, punitive, and exemplary losses, regardless of cause, foreseeability, or the amount of fees paid under this Agreement.

title: One-Sided Indemnification
text: The Customer shall defend, indemnify, and hold harmless the Supplier and its affiliates against every claim, loss, fine, cost, or expense arising directly or indirectly from the Agreement, including claims caused in whole or in part by the Supplier's negligence, misconduct, or breach.

title: No Supplier Responsibility
text: To the maximum extent asserted by this clause, the Supplier disclaims all responsibility for service failure, data loss, security incidents, bodily injury, or damage arising from its performance, while the Customer's obligations remain unlimited. title: Supplier's Immediate Termination Right
text: The Supplier may terminate this Agreement immediately and without notice for any alleged breach, including a minor or disputed breach. The Customer has no contractual cure period.

title: Five-Year Exit Liability
text: If this Agreement ends for any reason before the end of its five-year term, the Customer shall immediately pay all fees and minimum purchase commitments that would have become due for the entire remaining term, together with all penalties and collection costs.

title: No Customer Termination Right
text: The Customer may not terminate, suspend, or decline renewal of this Agreement for convenience, financial hardship, service interruption, or repeated Supplier failure.

title: Broad Non-Competition Restriction
text: During the Agreement and for five years after termination, the Customer shall not develop, purchase, sell, or support any product or service that competes directly or indirectly with the Supplier, in any country.

title: Unilateral Changes
text: The Supplier may amend prices, service descriptions, payment deadlines, and other material terms at any time by posting a notice on a website. Continued use is deemed acceptance, and the Customer has no right to reject the changes or terminate without penalty.

title: Assignment and Data Use
text: The Supplier may transfer this Agreement and any Customer data to any third party without notice or consent. The Customer may not assign any right or obligation under this Agreement without the Supplier's prior written approval.

title: Supplier-Controlled Disputes
text: The Supplier alone may select the governing law, venue, and dispute-resolution process after a dispute arises. The Customer waives objections to the selected forum and shall pay the Supplier's legal costs regardless of outcome.

title: No Meaningful Remedy
text: The Customer agrees that service credits are its exclusive remedy for any Supplier failure, while the Supplier retains all rights to recover unlimited damages, penalties, and future fees from the Customer.
